headline: France's Annual Inflation Slows to 2.9% in November on Falling Energy Prices
summary: Consumer prices in France fell by 0.7% in November, bringing the annual inflation rate down to 2.9% as energy costs declined.
why: Inflation metrics guide European Central Bank monetary policy decisions regarding interest rates and price stability targets.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: A 0.7% monthly drop in consumer prices directly reduced the annual inflation rate.
